purpose: Define district-level verification of the frozen Track B models BEFORE any district-level skill score is computed, so definitions cannot be chosen after seeing results.

2024.label: Track B 2024 validation/selection year: development evidence (M1 was selected on it; not a holdout)

2025.label: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2025 FINAL TEST

frozen_inputs.weights: data/manifests/phase2c/district_weights.npy (Phase 2C overlap weights, shared with Track A)
frozen_inputs.fields: frozen M0-M4 predictions and IMD observations on the paired valid cells (Phase 4I 2024, Phase 4J 2025)
frozen_inputs.valid_cell_rule: a cell contributes only if raw, model and IMD are all finite and its district weight is > 0 (identical to docs/107)

unit_of_analysis: district-case pair: one district in one paired case (initialization date x lead)

coverage_rule.reason: districts covered by few valid IMD land cells make area-based quantities and 'any cell' events dominated by one or two cells
coverage_rule.observed_support_note: 19 of 188 districts have a median below 5 valid cells in both 2024 and 2025 and are excluded (169 kept). Every paired case has the same 1,301 valid cells, so each district's valid-cell count is constant across cases and the pair rule equals the district rule.

continuous_metrics.quantity: area-weighted district mean (mm/24h) for Raw, M1-M4 and IMD
continuous_metrics.per_district: reported only for districts with at least 30 included cases

event_definitions.E1_any_cell: district event if at least one valid cell of the district is >= threshold (applied identically to the forecast field and to IMD)
event_definitions.E2_area_25pct: district event if the area-weighted share of valid cells >= threshold is >= 0.25 (applied identically to forecast and IMD)
event_definitions.E3_district_mean: district event if the district area-weighted mean >= threshold (sensitivity only; support is too thin for very heavy rain)
event_definitions.primary_rationale: E1 keeps the most observed events (after the 5-cell rule: heavy 3,227 / 3,845 district-case events in 2024 / 2025; very heavy 1,106 / 1,117) and is closest to point-event warning language; its dependence on the number of valid cells is controlled by the 5-cell coverage rule and by pairing every model with Raw inside the same district-case pair
event_definitions.alternative_considered: E2 as primary: more spatially meaningful but only 10-12 districts reach 30 heavy events and none reach 30 very-heavy events (observation-only counts); E2 is reported as secondary
event_definitions.forecast_and_observed_symmetry: the identical rule is applied to the model's district cells and to IMD on the same valid cells

categorical_metrics.pooled_over: included district-case pairs; undefined values stay undefined with counts, never 0
categorical_metrics.per_district: reported only for districts with at least 30 OBSERVED events under the definition (support from IMD alone, fixed before looking at any model)
categorical_metrics.very_heavy: pooled metrics reported; per-district metrics reported only where the same support rule is met, otherwise 'insufficient support'

paired_comparison.continuous: improvement_vs_raw per district-case pair = |Raw mean - IMD mean| - |model mean - IMD mean| (positive = closer to IMD); summarised per district as the mean over its cases
paired_comparison.districts_improved_worsened: a district is 'improved' if its mean improvement > 0 and the 95 % paired case-cluster bootstrap interval of that mean excludes 0, 'worsened' if < 0 and the interval excludes 0, otherwise 'indeterminate'; with a two-sided 95 % interval about 5 % of tested districts in total (about 2.5 % per direction) would be classified improved or worsened by chance even with no true effect, so counts are reported next to that expected-by-chance number
paired_comparison.uncertainty: paired bootstrap resampling WHOLE CASES (all districts of a case together), 2000 draws, seed 26080; optimistic because consecutive days are correlated and neighbouring districts within a case are correlated

secondary_breakdowns: by forecast-only pseudo-regime (argmax of the frozen classifier)
by region: latitude band 10-14N, 14-18N, 18-22N of the district centroid (declared lookup)
reporting_rules: No metric is reported without its denominator (cases / district-case pairs / observed events).
No per-district score is reported below the support thresholds above; it is shown as 'insufficient support'.
2025 is a consumed holdout: results are POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2025 FINAL TEST and must not select, tune or re-rank any model.
Pseudo-regimes are forecast-only classifier labels, not observed meteorological truth.
These are district-aggregate verification statistics of historical replay, not warning skill.
forbidden: changing an event definition, threshold, support rule or coverage rule after results are computed
reporting a district-level skill figure computed before this protocol is approved
pooling Track A and Track B

observation_only_support_counts.note: Computed from IMD observations and the frozen valid-cell mask only; no model value was read. Counts after the approved >= 5 valid-cell rule (169 of 188 districts kept).

decisions.coverage_rule: >= 5 valid cells per district-case (stricter than the proposed 3)
decisions.regional_grouping: three latitude bands 10-14N, 14-18N, 18-22N of the district centroid (as proposed)
decisions.commit_policy: keep working; do not commit yet

approval.note: Decisions were taken after the observation-only support counts (IMD only; no model value read) and before any district-level skill score was computed.

region_rule: district centroid = centroid of the district polygon clipped to the 10-22N, 68-80E domain box; band edges 14N and 18N (a centroid exactly on an edge belongs to the northern band)

per_district_outputs.continuous: RMSE, MAE, bias of the district mean for Raw and M1-M4, for districts with at least 30 included cases
per_district_outputs.categorical: for E1 and E2 (E3 pooled only): hits, misses, false alarms, POD, FAR, CSI, ETS per model for districts with at least 30 OBSERVED events under that definition and threshold; otherwise 'insufficient_support'
per_district_outputs.improvement: mean of (|Raw err| - |model err|) with the 95 % paired case-cluster bootstrap interval and status improved/worsened/indeterminate

reproduction_gate: builder recomputes the observation-only support counts and must match the protocol's counts exactly
district means for a sample of cases and all models must equal the means recomputed from the already-served 49x49 rainfall grids
pooled district-mean RMSE for Raw computed by the vectorised path must equal an independent per-district loop
sum over districts of observed events equals the pooled observed events
